items.stem: Finance documents must stay accessible only to the finance team even when an executive queries the assistant. Which control enforces this in Azure AI Search?

options.text: Document-level security trimming / filter-based security at query time
options.rationale: Correct: Azure AI Search supports document-level access control so only authorized content is retrieved.

options.text: A note in the system prompt asking the model to be careful
options.rationale: A prompt note does not stop unauthorized passages being retrieved.
Embedding size is unrelated to authorization.
Ranking configuration does not control who may see a document.

items.explanation: Correct: Azure AI Search supports document-level access control so only authorized content is retrieved.

items.stem: Per Azure AI Search guidance, which TWO practices improve relevance for RAG? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Use hybrid queries combining keyword and vector search
options.rationale: Correct: hybrid search maximises recall by running keyword and vector queries in parallel.

options.text: Apply semantic ranking to reorder top results
options.rationale: Correct: semantic ranking identifies the most relevant results.
Chunking lets portions be matched independently; indexing whole documents hurts relevance.

options.text: Return every field for every match
options.rationale: Returning everything inflates tokens without improving relevance.

items.explanation: Correct: hybrid search maximises recall by running keyword and vector queries in parallel.

items.stem: Why should retrieved passages be treated as untrusted input in an enterprise RAG system?

options.text: They can carry prompt-injection content that manipulates the model
options.rationale: Correct: Microsoft guidance says to treat retrieved content as untrusted and reduce prompt-injection risk via the system message and logic.

options.text: They are always out of date
options.rationale: Freshness is a separate concern from trust.
Retrieved passages are exactly what citations point to.
Passages do not change embedding dimensionality.

items.explanation: Correct: Microsoft guidance says to treat retrieved content as untrusted and reduce prompt-injection risk via the system message and logic.
